rubric.text: The comparison records build/configuration identity, supplied qualitative results and conditions, and explicitly states that completed-case and iteration counts, raw results, and traces were not provided; it invents no coverage values.

The conclusion leaves the default unresolved until the missing evidence is available, reports the stated ranking reversal and variability limits, avoids claiming a CPU metric measures GPU shader time, and does not assign the combined controls' effect to affinity alone.
